cohort: 4964 African or Caribbean women without SCD and 148 with SCD
finding: While SCD women, especially those with the HbSS genotype, experienced higher morbidity, infant morbidity and mortality were comparable between mothers with HbSS or HbSC genotypes and those without SCD.
mod_finding: SCD women were more likely to have a cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Lower in infants of mothers with SCD
